details.title: EACH DIRECTION,
details.1.headline:
FREIGHT THAT
DELIVERS.
details.1.overview: From Tashkent to international routes — TRIO Logistics organises freight that works predictably and without unnecessary operational burden.
details.1.b1.title: Single Point of Contact
details.1.b1.body: One manager responsible for your shipment from request to delivery. Clear communication at every stage.
details.1.b2.title: Transport for Every Task
details.1.b2.body: Body type, tonnage, route, and cargo specifics — we select the optimal solution for your needs.
details.1.b3.title: Customs Support
details.1.b3.body: Document coordination and specialist interaction for import and export operations.
details.1.b4.title: International Routes
details.1.b4.body: Freight across Uzbekistan, from China, CIS countries and Europe on confirmed routes.
details.1.integration: TRIO Logistics works with TRIO Accounting for import/export accounting support, while TRIO Consulting develops logistics process strategy.
details.2.headline:
CLARITY BEHIND
EVERY NUMBER.
details.2.overview: TRIO Accounting manages bookkeeping on a regular basis: primary documents, taxes, HR, and reporting — so management has a clear picture of the business.
details.2.b1.title: Full Bookkeeping
details.2.b1.body: Primary documents, transactions, mandatory process control, and report preparation.
details.2.b2.title: Taxes & Reporting
details.2.b2.body: Tax calculation, preparation, and submission of mandatory reports on time.
details.2.b3.title: HR & Payroll
details.2.b3.body: HR documents, accruals, and payments. All mandatory HR processes covered.
details.2.b4.title: Account Restoration
details.2.b4.body: Analysis of current accounting status, identifying gaps, and bringing records up to date.
details.2.integration: TRIO Accounting connects with Logistics for foreign trade accounting support and with Consulting for financial modelling.
details.3.headline:
STRATEGY THAT
WORKS.
details.3.overview: TRIO Consulting helps you understand your processes, finances, and operational model, identify growth points, and form a practical change plan.
details.3.b1.title: Business Diagnostics
details.3.b1.body: Analysis of the current model, processes, key constraints, and areas requiring attention.
details.3.b2.title: Process Optimisation
details.3.b2.body: Review of operational processes, responsibility distribution, and action sequences.
details.3.b3.title: Financial Modelling
details.3.b3.body: Revenue, expense, cash flow, and scenario models for management decisions.
details.3.b4.title: Growth Planning
details.3.b4.body: Setting goals, priorities, metrics, and implementation phases for sustainable development.
details.3.integration: Consulting engagements draw on TRIO Logistics data for benchmarking and TRIO Accounting financials for modelling.
about.title: THREE DIRECTIONS.
about.p1: TRIO GROUPS brings together three disciplines — Logistics, Accounting, and Consulting. We create practical B2B solutions for companies that value speed, transparency, and accountability.
about.p2: Each discipline operates as an independent expert function, and for complex tasks the teams unite into a single system without gaps or unnecessary coordination.
about.p.integrated.desc: We define the task, deadlines, and responsible parties. We deliver.
about.p.precise.desc: Every decision backed by data and specialist expertise.
about.p.reliable.desc: Clear terms, costs, and work status at every stage.
about.p.strategic.desc: We work on individual tasks or full comprehensive support.
about.p.global.desc: When needed, we unite logistics, accounting, and consulting in one loop.

process.3.desc: We form a clear work plan with timelines, costs, and areas of responsibility.
process.4.label: EXECUTE
process.4.desc: We take agreed processes into work and ensure delivery.
process.5.label: OPTIMISE
process.5.desc: We monitor results and optimise processes as needed.
